values.note: Developed RV site (electric and water) $50 a night, $60 on holidays; primitive tent sites $42-55, group site $110, cabins $80-90. Covert Township residents get 10% off camping. Extra vehicle $10, pets $3 each a day; dump fee on site.

note: Small campground set back in a wooded area a short walk from the lake. --AWH  Township park on 50 acres of Lake Michigan critical dunes; a paved path and a wooded staircase and boardwalk lead to dune overlooks and a quarter mile of beach. No alcohol anywhere in the park. --Claude
summary: Covert Township's park site (2026): developed RV sites (electric + water) $50, holiday $60, residents 10% off; showers, dump (fee), camp store; open Apr 17-Oct 15, 2026; booked online through innRoad from Jan 1, 14-night max. Amperage, site count and max length are only on the per-site booking pages (not read). Kept the --AWH note and added the setting and the no-alcohol rule.
